query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.name = 'op_log' THEN d.pgsize END), 0) AS "table_bytes!: i64", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.name <> 'op_log' THEN d.pgsize END), 0) AS "index_bytes!: i64" FROM dbstat AS d WHERE d.aggregate = TRUE AND d.name IN (SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE tbl_name = 'op_log' AND type IN ('table', 'index'))
